title: Chapter 779
paragraphs: Chapter 779
Episode 191. The People Who Lead the Times (3)
The magical power shown by Meri and Heytona was a little beyond the basic level.
However, the important thing was that the training period for the Knights had only been about a month. Jin could not understand the pace of his brothers' growth and blinked in astonishment.
This was because it was impossible without talent like Jin and Valeria.
[Since you, Lord, know the process of magicians growing, the achievements of the Knights will be particularly surprising.]
"Could it be that my brothers have a genius talent for magic?"
[Surprisingly, all of the Knights have excellent sense for magic. However, they're not geniuses like you, Lord.]
"Then...?"
[I have been passing on the memories of when I learned magic to the Knights. You could say, it's a sort of transmission.]
Hister, the memory magicians, not only leave their own memories in the transmission papers but also memories about magic and magical power to their descendants.
"I thought that was only possible for the same memory magicians."
Jin had thought that such benefits were only allowed for the same Histors, especially for 'Full Mana Bodies' like Valeria.

[When I heard about the transmission paper from Valeria, I wondered if I, being the root, could do the same or something similar. So, I tried a few experiments, and I discovered that it was possible to pass on my memories to pure-blood Runecandles.]
The reason why this is only possible for pure-blood Runecandles is simple.

The 'memory transmission' that Leat discovered was possible through her divine power and the bond built with Temar a thousand years ago. If the recipient had no relation to Temar, no matter the method used, the transmission did not occur.
Even though pure-blood Runecandles have never met Temar, they share the same blood.
Only those who possessed the blessed bodies of Runecandle could receive memory transmission from Leat. Just like when Jin received half of the senses through 'fusion with a god'.
As Leat explained this, Jin's eyes sparkled the entire time.
"This is a tremendous discovery, steward. But I doubt there are absolutely no restrictions or costs involved."

[You're correct. First, when I transmit memories, I become significantly mentally exhausted. Also, the Knights are gaining a sense for handling mana through my memories of learning magic, but they cannot perfectly realize it. Even if they understand it in their heads, their bodies do not follow. And there are not a few memories that are omitted.]

This was also true for 'fusion with a god.' If the synchronization was at its peak, one could use the senses of a god as is, but when it was insufficient, it was not the case. As experienced in the Demon God Temple, if the synchronization is too high, one can lose their sense of self.

[In the future, whenever I have time, I plan to improve all the Knights' magic abilities in this way, except for yours, Lord. Since the mana suppressed by the manipulation of history is revealing itself all at once, if only knowledge and sense are met, they will quickly be able to use quite destructive magic... ugh.]
Leat staggered forward as if she would collapse.
"Steward!"
"Steward, are you alright?"

Though she seemed fine on the outside, among the Runecandle members right now, Leat was the one suffering the most from overwork. Her body could not keep up as she was not only dealing with steward duties but also transmitting memories.
[I'm fine. As you said, Lord, it's true that I need rest and recharge. Please excuse me for a moment.]
Leat said, opening the window wide. She then leaned her head outside and took several deep breaths.
[Phew! I'm glad the day is fresh, the clean air has cleared my whole body. I'm okay now.]
"Surely, you're not calling this rest?"

[Originally, fairies can regain energy at any time with just wind and dew. That's why I was able to perform the duty of recording day and night. Anyway, now the Knights are also becoming magic swordsmen. We don't know when the showdown with the enemies will be, but they must somehow become stronger before that happens.]
Nobody knows when the war will start. There is a non-aggression treaty for a year, but that's just a nice story.

The reason why the great powers are not attacking each other right now is that neither side has gained an overwhelming power. The world's strongest excluding Shiron is definitely Jin now, but the power is definitely not so.
For example, the world is in a state of unstable balance. The moment one side strikes and advances, a war will definitely start.
"Can't we just avoid war and maintain this era of peace?"
Many had these thoughts. Even Jin would have seriously considered this issue if the only desire of the other major powers was to cultivate and govern their own lands.
However, they want to become the only king in the world.
Jin only wants to reach the pinnacle of his family, but they want to have the whole of humanity under their feet and change the world to their liking.
In Jin's eyes, either Zifel or Kinzelo, whoever ascends to the earthly throne, are those who would turn the world into hell.
So Jin stands in their way. He wants to end the thousand-year war, remove the strange things like the Devil Stones, the Sun God, the Chaos, and reclaim a normal world.
What Jin wants most is to enjoy a healthy life with his kin in that world.

"Well, shall we talk a little about the recent political situation? From the information we have, it's clear that we are making the fastest and most significant progress. You, the Lord, have virtually reached the top of the world's greatest sword, we are constantly attracting talents, and we have obtained various new technologies."
"But the enemies are too quiet."

"I think so too, my Lord. No matter how much they fear you, there should have been an attempt to curb us. Especially since you have been consistently provocative and radical towards our enemies after the Evil Temple incident."

Such as the existence of the predecessors, which clearly exist through the soul, and the incidents where he publicized the records of the Evil Temple to the public without their consent and revealed the relationship between Valeria and Zifel.
They were all things that Zifel and Kinzelo, especially Zifel, had to find displeasing. Even considering Jin's burdensome actions, they only show a passive reaction.
"In my opinion, there's something else besides you, my Lord. Let's take a look at these."
Luett spread out reports on the desk. These were reports containing recent trends of Kinzelo and Zifel.
"Kinzelo and Zifel, both are primarily focused on internal stability."

Both forces had oddly little contact with the outside world. Like when the Holy Kingdom declared seclusion, they were not meeting with any neutral forces. It was a sight contrary to Run Candel's continuous incorporation of neutral forces.

In the war of the giant powers, the strength of the remaining neutral forces in the world cannot occupy a large area. The strongest neutral forces like Bi-kung, Moo-myoung, Heuk-wangdan, and Ghost Group have already been incorporated by Jin a long time ago.

"There's no reason to ignore neutral forces like this. Even to prevent them from being absorbed by us, it would be right to move. Yet, they are still, making me think they are preparing for something."
"Preparation... Kinzelo will be focusing on recruiting demons and finding Rokia."
At the mention of Rokia's name, Luett's face darkened for a moment.

"The fact that Rokia might be a traitor is still a big shock to me. I need to fully recover my memories from that time to understand the full story. Although the circumstances suggest her betrayal, it seems certain."
"Let's wait for Orugal to share any related clues."

[Yes, Lord SoGaJoo. As you feared after the last visit to the New Headquarters, Kinjero is still replenishing its demonic forces. It is certain that they have created a passage leading to the demon world somewhere, but its location has not been identified yet. Should we allocate more personnel?]
Ranke had said that it wasn't the 'playground', the Mitra desert. However, Runecandel was still collecting information about the desert.

"No, let's continue to investigate cautiously as we are now, since we don't have to find it right away. The day I went to the New Headquarters, Orugal was in a bad mood for some reason and acted as if he wanted to fight me right there... There must have been a reason to warn me not to be reckless. Now is not the time to provoke unnecessarily."
[It makes sense that they didn't want to show Lord SoGaJoo the replenishing demon forces. Hiding one's power is natural.]

"However, if they are trying to hide their power to the point of disregarding a fight with me, they probably aren't confident yet. Let's increase our strength slowly, while analyzing their power and the combat abilities of the demons."
[Understood. Since Shagal Bahama, whom you subdued at the New Headquarters, is a member of the Illusion Horse tribe, I will first look for information related to him.]
"Still no contact from Zipl since we ignored the purification machine request last time. I guess it's because the condition of Kelliac is beyond what the purification machine can handle."

[Yes, and while Zipl keeps publishing articles stating that we are instigating a new war after the last one, all they're doing is keeping an eye on our main transportation methods. They are completely unaware of the Blacksmith's Island.]
"Is there any indication that the steel trade with Kinjero was successful?"
[Yes, Zipl is buying steel from Kinjero at a higher price than what you offered to Orugal.]

"Keep instructing our informants in the Rutero Federation's black market to pretend that we need steel. They'll release some goods at a very high price, and we'll have to purchase some to deceive them."
[Understood. And here, there's a strange point in the most recent report.]
Jin's gaze landed on the report.
"Cadun often reveals his discomfort?"
[Yes, for some reason, he has been causing a lot of trouble within the Federation recently. Even our spies who haven't infiltrated deeply can tell.]

"He's always been a dragon with a rough and reckless nature, but if reports like this are coming in, he must be piling up some dissatisfaction. Is it because Zipl isn't more actively requesting us to use the purification machine for Kelliac?"
As Jin said that.
Suddenly, an informant hurried into the office.
"Lord SoGaJoo, Chief of Staff! A report has come in from the spies in the Federation."
[Speak.]
"Three days ago, there was a huge explosion and vibration near Zipl's first tower! It's suspected to be due to a battle!"
